title: OWNER (Coconala only): allow mac-local to submit Coconala proposals, or send the ready draft for 5303405 yourself
detail: mac-local found a fit (https://coconala.com/requests/5303405, ¥5k-10k, deadline 10/12) and the draft is ready in marketing/2026-10/h1/screens/2026-10-02.md ('Ready-to-send draft for 5303405'), but pressing 応募する on your Coconala account is blocked by the Mac's Claude auto-mode safety check (Real-World Transactions) — an owner permission boundary the AI must not bypass. Choose one: (a) send the draft yourself on coconala.com (~3 min); or (b) allow unattended Coconala proposal submission for the mac-local supervisor's Claude runs (a permission rule in the Mac's Claude Code settings) — then every future H1 proposal goes out without you. Constitution Art.10 already authorizes proposals; this is only the runtime permission.
